home.title: Vasilka Sotirova | Bulgarian Artist — Original Oil and Pastel Paintings
home.description: Vasilka Sotirova is a Bulgarian artist and painter from Varna, working in oil, acrylic, dry pastel and watercolour. Portraits, pet portraits, landscapes, still life and abstract art — original paintings and commissions, shipped worldwide.
intro: Vasilka Sotirova is a Bulgarian artist, born in Varna in 1965. She trained at the High School of Applied Arts in Tryavna and graduated from the University of Fine Arts in Dupnitsa, and has painted for more than three decades in oil, acrylic, dry pastel and watercolour.

Her work moves between commissioned portraits and pet portraits, the mountains, meadows and old towns of Bulgaria, still life, and abstract painting. Her paintings are held in private collections across Europe and North America, and original work is available to commission and ship worldwide.

portraits.title: Portraits
portraits.description: Commissioned portrait paintings by Bulgarian artist Vasilka Sotirova — oil and dry pastel portraits of children, couples and families, painted from life or from photographs. Portrait commissions shipped worldwide.

animal-portraits.title: Animal Portraits
animal-portraits.description: Pet and animal portraits by Bulgarian painter Vasilka Sotirova — dogs, cats and horses in oil and dry pastel, including close studies of horses in movement. Custom pet portrait commissions welcome.

still-life.title: Still Life
still-life.description: Still life paintings by Bulgarian artist Vasilka Sotirova — poppies, sunflowers, roses and garden flowers in oil, with fruit and tabletop studies in rich, saturated colour.

landscapes.title: Landscapes
landscapes.description: Bulgarian landscape paintings by Vasilka Sotirova — mountain ridges, glacial lakes, wildflower meadows and the Black Sea coast, painted in oil with bold, high-key colour.

abstract-landscapes.title: Abstract Landscapes
abstract-landscapes.description: Abstract landscape paintings by Bulgarian artist Vasilka Sotirova, where meadows, trees and distant hills dissolve into colour, texture and atmosphere.

architectural-landscapes.title: Architectural Landscapes
architectural-landscapes.description: Paintings of Bulgarian Revival architecture by Vasilka Sotirova — old town streets, stone bridges, clock towers and red-roofed houses in oil and watercolour.

abstract-paintings.title: Abstract Paintings
abstract-paintings.description: Abstract paintings by Bulgarian artist Vasilka Sotirova — bold colour fields, and musicians and figures reduced to gesture, in oil and acrylic.

other-nature-scenes.title: Other Nature Scenes
other-nature-scenes.description: Nature paintings by Bulgarian artist Vasilka Sotirova — butterflies, poppies, orchids and close studies drawn from the natural world.

current-exhibition.title: Current Exhibition
current-exhibition.description: The most recently exhibited paintings by Bulgarian artist Vasilka Sotirova, available as originals and prints.

bio.heading: Bio
bio.title: Biography | Vasilka Sotirova, Bulgarian Painter
bio.description: Biography of Vasilka Sotirova, a Bulgarian painter born in Varna in 1965 — training in Tryavna and Dupnitsa, and paintings held in private collections across Europe and North America.
timeline: Born in the city of Varna.
Graduated from the High School of Applied Arts in the town of Tryavna.
Graduated from the University of Fine Arts "Todor Samodumov" in the town of Dupnitsa.
Postgraduate degree in "Pedagogy of the Plastic Arts".
bio.note: Her paintings are owned by private individuals from Bulgaria, Germany, Russia, France, Norway, Sweden, Denmark, England, Canada, the USA and others.
